title: Drop Python 3.9 support and align Poetry/CI
description: Raise the project Python floor to 3.10, update CI matrix and tool targets, and validate Poetry install/test flow.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Started follow-up fix for Poetry CI failure. Plan: drop Python 3.9 support (raise floor to 3.10), update CI test matrix, adjust tool target versions, run poetry check/install/ruff/tests, and push.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented fix: dropped Python 3.9 support to resolve Poetry installation/matrix issues. Changes made: requires-python set to >=3.10,<4.0; Black and Ruff targets set to py310; CI matrix removed 3.9; docs updated where minimum version was stated as 3.9. Regenerated poetry.lock and validated: poetry lock, poetry install --with dev --extras datasets, poetry run ruff check src/biblicus/, poetry run python scripts/test.py (pass).
